message.content: {"draft":"Single-pass row softmax. One program per row. Load row, subtract max, exp, sum, divide, store. Use next power-of-two block. Cast to FP32 for math, store back to original dtype.","plan":"Keep one program per row. Use next power-of-two block. Load with mask, other=-inf. Compute max, exp, sum in FP32. Divide. Store with mask. Allocate fresh output.","code_lines":["import torch","import triton","import triton.language as tl","","","@triton.jit","def _softmax_kernel(","    output_ptr,","    input_ptr,","    input_row_stride,","    output_row_stride,","    n_cols,","    BLOCK_SIZE: tl.constexpr,","    IS_BF16: tl.constexpr,","    IS_FP32: tl.constexpr,","):","    row_idx = tl.program_id(0)","    row_start_ptr = input_ptr + row_idx * input_row_stride","    col_offsets = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE)","    mask = col_offsets < n_cols","    row = tl.load(row_start_ptr + col_offsets, mask=mask, other=-float('inf'))","    if IS_BF16:","        row = row.to(tl.float32)","    elif IS_FP32:","        row = row.to(tl.float32)","    else:","        row = row.to(tl.float32)","    row_max = tl.max(row, axis=0)","    numerator = tl.exp(row - row_max)","    denominator = tl.sum(numerator, axis=0)","    softmax_output = numerator / denominator","    if IS_BF16:","        softmax_output = softmax_output.to(tl.bfloat16)","    elif IS_FP32:","        softmax_output = softmax_output.to(tl.float32)","    else:","        softmax_output = softmax_output.to(tl.float32)","    output_row_start_ptr = output_ptr + row_idx * output_row_stride","    tl.store(output_row_start_ptr + col_offsets, softmax_output, mask=mask)","    return","","","def run(x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:","    assert x.is_cuda and x.dim() == 2 and x.is_contiguous()","    n_rows, n_cols = x.shape","    output = torch.empty_like(x)","    BLOCK_SIZE = 1 << (n_cols - 1).bit_length()","    grid = (n_rows,)","    is_bf16 = x.dtype == torch.bfloat16","    is_fp32 = x.dtype == torch.float32","    _softmax_kernel[grid](","        output,","        x,","        n_cols,","        n_cols,","        n_cols,","        BLOCK_SIZE=BLOCK_SIZE,","        IS_BF16=is_bf16,","        IS_FP32=is_fp32,","    )","    return output"]}
